ajordan: acked — oncall here, looking now :eyes:

sara: seeing a big jump in 502/504s in eu-west1. Traffic surge from mobile region. Dashboard: https://dash.example/ingw/errors?range=5m

leo: confirmed, spike started ~30s ago. Pod logs show a lot of upstream timeouts to model-host-1 and model-host-2. Sample error: `HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout`

mina: adding a note — we've got prefix-cache warmup running concurrently, might be increasing backend load.

ajordan: running quick checks — curl to local edge returns 200, but requests proxied to model pool show 502s. Running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep gateway`

ops-bot: Command output pasted:
```

```

ajordan: looking at envoy stats — upstream_retries and 5xx both spike. Dumping last 2m of envoy logs: https://logs.example/q=inc-3101234567

sara: quick mitigation — can we temporarily route eu-west1 traffic to eu-west2? eu-west2 is healthy per metrics.

leo: we have a traffic-policy that supports regional failover. I'll flip fallback to prefer eu-west2 for this service. Doing it now.

ops-bot: PATCH /routing/policies/inference-gateway -> {"prefer_regions": ["eu-west2","eu-west1"]} — 200 OK

ajordan: updated routing. Watching error rate.

(1m later)

mina: error rate dropped from 7.4% to 1.1% on eu-west1 traffic after partial failover. Overall 5xx% back to ~0.9% — :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: Acknowledgement recorded by ajordan at 3101234572

sara: digging into model-host-1 logs — seeing repeated NGNX upstream connect timeouts around 15:14:22 UTC. Host CPU and network look fine. Possible issue with model process accepting connections (socket backlog).

leo: I can try restarting one model-host replica to see if it evicts a bad process. Planning rolling restart of model-host-1 pool, one at a time.

ajordan: go ahead with one replica restart. We'll keep routing failover until hosts healthy.

ops-bot: Command executed: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-host -n inference --selector=pool=eu-west1 --timeout=5m`

(rolling restart in progress)

mina: first replica restarted, error rate dipped further. No customer tickets yet. Logging note: customer-impact-tag=none so far.

ajordan: keeping pager open until stability for 15m. If stable, we'll close and file RCA.

sara: saved traces for a few sample requests to S3: s3://redwood-incident-traces/3101234567/ — includes envoy + model logs for correlated requests.

leo: follow-up actions: 1) investigate root cause on model process (thread limits/socket handling) 2) add circuit-breaker to upstream cluster for fast failover 3) add health-check improvement to detect accept() stalls.

ajordan: creating a follow-up ticket and will attach traces. Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-sre. Ticket: https://tickets.example/INC-3101234567-FOLLOWUP

pagerduty: Incident status updated: acknowledged -> monitoring

(15m after initial)

ajordan: 15m check — error rate stable <1% for 20m, traffic fully back to eu-west1 (we gradually routed back). Closing pager now.
